补充：设计取舍、重点代码与阅读路径

设计目的：前端 core hooks 把 UI 与 API 解耦，是为了组件只关心状态而不是请求细节。

维度

说明

收益

收益是复用强；代价是缓存更新和乐观状态较复杂。

代价

见收益说明中的代价部分；此章节采用收益与代价合并描述。

重点代码

重点代码：frontend/src/core/threads/hooks.ts、frontend/src/core/messages/utils.ts。

阅读路径

阅读路径：hook 是数据层，component 是展示层。

flowchart TD Send[sendMessage] --> Opt[setOptimisticMessages] Send --> Upload[uploadFiles] Upload --> Submit[thread.submit] Submit --> Stream[useStream live events] Stream --> Created[onCreated] Created --> Cache1[upsertThreadInSearchCache] Created --> Cache2[upsertThreadInInfiniteCache] Stream --> Update[onUpdateEvent] Update --> Title[update title in query cache] Stream --> Custom[onCustomEvent] Custom --> Subtask[updateSubtask task_running] Custom --> Retry[toast llm_retry] Stream --> Err[onError] Err --> Clear[clear optimistic messages] Stream --> Fin[onFinish] Fin --> Invalidate[invalidate search and token usage] Stream --> Persisted[thread.messages persisted] Hist[useThreadHistory] --> RunMsgs[run messages by before_seq] RunMsgs --> Merge[mergeMessages] Opt --> Merge Persisted --> Merge RunMsgs --> Merge Merge --> Groups[getMessageGroups] Groups --> Render[MessageList render]
